Profile Raclopride is a substituted benzamide related to sulpiride (p.1028). It has been investigated for the treatment of psychoses. Since it binds selectively and with high affinity to D2 dopamin- ergic receptors, raclopride labelled with carbon-11 has been tried as a tracer in computerised tomographic studies of neurological disorders associated with dysfunction of brain D2 dopaminergic receptors.
